title: iSHELL a 1 to 5 micron cross-dispersed spectrograph for the NASA IRTF
what_was_studied: Cryogenic spectrograph design, modes and commissioning
numerical_result: The instrument spans roughly 1.06 to 5.3 micrometres and reaches resolving power near 80000 in current facility documentation
remaining_question: General spectroscopic capability does not imply precision-RV performance in every setting

title: Precise radial velocities in the near infrared
what_was_studied: Gas-cell forward modelling for three nearby stars
numerical_result: About 5 m/s was demonstrated over roughly one year and GJ 15 A reached about 3 m/s over one month
remaining_question: Results depend on target brightness, cadence and baseline

title: NASA IRTF data search documentation
what_was_studied: Public discovery and retrieval of iSHELL observations
numerical_result: The archive permits searches by instrument, programme and date but does not supply a homogeneous RV product
remaining_question: A reproducible analysis must define raw-data selection and reduction version

title: NASA IRTF semester 2026B information
what_was_studied: Current availability and documented RV limitations
numerical_result: IRTF lists iSHELL as available; the page reports about 10 m/s for targets brighter than K 10 and 3 to 5 m/s for bright K about 4 stars, with roughly 25 RV epochs per semester at most
remaining_question: The facility statement combines several samples and notes year-scale systematics
